task.description: Produce a Type E prose fix design (src/design/iss0100-tenant-fixture-hygiene.md) implementing BOTH fixes recommended in docs/issue-reports/ISS-0100-diagnosis.yaml: (1) PRIMARY — every disposable integration-test tenant fixture INSERT that currently omits tenant_type/storage_mode must be updated to set tenant_type='test' and production_tenant_id=<the default tenant's id> (satisfying migrations/GBL-080_env01_tenant_type_field.sql's ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence CHECK constraint: tenant_type='test' requires production_tenant_id IS NOT NULL). Use tests/integration/env01_tenant_type_field_test.zig as the reference pattern for how to look up/pass the default tenant id and construct the INSERT. Enumerate the exact INSERT statements to change: tests/integration/helpers.zig (ensureDefaultOidcSeeds SVC-01..04 block, ~9 rows: svc-t1, svc-t2, svc04-upd-tn, svc04-cnf-ow, svc04-cnf-ot, svc04-inuse-t, svc04-lst-ta, svc04-lst-tb, svc04-all-t), tests/integration/svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig (2 inserts), tests/integration/svc04_admin_api_test.zig, tests/integration/adp07_agent_role_reserved_usernames_test.zig, tests/integration/adp04a_external_identity_linkage_test.zig, tests/integration/tenant_config_realm_test.zig, tests/integration/oidc09_test.zig, oidc10_test.zig, oidc11_test.zig, oidc12_test.zig, oidc15_test.zig, oidc35_test.zig (confirm exact filenames via grep — the diagnosis report found 36 total INSERT statements across 20 files; only the ones NOT already setting tenant_type deliberately need to change — env0*_test.zig and iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test.zig are already correct and must NOT be touched). (2) SUPPLEMENTARY — migrations/GBL-084_rls_removal.sql's pre-flight guard COUNT query must add 'AND tenant_type = ''production''' so it only counts real production tenants, not test fixtures that haven't been cleaned up yet. Since GBL-084 has very likely already been recorded as applied in most environments (per test_iss503_rls_removal.zig's own header comment), determine whether this requires a NEW migration file (if GBL-084 is already applied and idempotent-guard-only changes to an already-applied migration file won't rerun) or whether editing GBL-084 in place is safe given the project's migration conventions — check docs/guides/backend_developer_guide.md and any migration-authoring conventions doc for the rule on modifying already-numbered migrations vs. adding a new one. Do not write actual Zig/SQL code in the design doc — describe the exact before/after INSERT column lists and values, the exact SQL diff for the guard, and the migration file decision (new file vs in-place edit) with rationale, so BACKEND-DEV can implement without ambiguity. List every requirement acceptance criterion covered. Also note in the design: this is a pure regression/test-hygiene fix that does not add or modify business logic — BACKEND-DEV should treat it as eligible for the WF-03 'PURE REGRESSION FIX' fast path (skip Step 4/4b TEST-DESIGNER, go straight to Step 5 TEST-RUNNER verification) unless CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR disagrees.
acceptance_criteria: Design lists every file + INSERT statement that must change, with exact new column/value additions (tenant_type='test', production_tenant_id=<default tenant id>)
Design explains how to obtain the default tenant's id in each affected test file (reuse existing pattern, e.g. a helper or a SELECT id FROM tenant WHERE slug='default')
Design specifies the exact SQL change to GBL-084's pre-flight guard COUNT query
Design makes an explicit, justified call on new-migration-file vs in-place-edit for the GBL-084 change
No implementation code (prose/SQL snippets illustrating intent are fine per Type E convention, but this is a design doc, not the final diff)
Explicitly confirms env0*_test.zig and iss107_tenant_storage_mode_test.zig are OUT of scope (already correct)
task.description_rework_1: REWORK 1 (from CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR, handoff wf03-iss0100-step-02b): Design content (SQL diffs, default-tenant UUID usage, GBL-086-vs-in-place-edit rationale, OUT-of-scope file list) was independently verified against source and is CORRECT — do not change any of that. The ONLY defect: Section 8 lists 13 files to touch in one pass, exceeding WF-03's hard 'A single fix iteration MUST touch <=5 source files' constraint (docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md, 'Fix size constraint'). This is NOT an architectural redesign situation (all 12 test-file edits are the same mechanical pattern — add tenant_type='test' + production_tenant_id to an existing INSERT — applied to a different file each time; the 13th is one self-contained new migration file). Restructure Section 8 into an explicit SEQUENCE of <=5-file fix iterations that BACKEND-DEV (and ORCH, dispatching repeated Step-3 handoffs) can execute one at a time, e.g.: Iteration 1 = migrations/GBL-086_iss503_guard_tenant_type_scope.sql + tests/integration/helpers.zig (2 files, the highest-leverage pair since helpers.zig seeds 9 of the leaked rows on every TestHarness.init()); Iteration 2 = svc01_service_catalog_scope_test.zig + svc04_admin_api_test.zig + adp07_agent_role_reserved_usernames_test.zig + adp04a_external_identity_linkage_test.zig + tenant_config_realm_test.zig (5 files); Iteration 3 = oidc09/10/11/12/15/35_*_test.zig (6 files — still exceeds 5, so split further into Iteration 3a = oidc09/10/11 (3 files) and Iteration 3b = oidc12/15/35 (3 files), OR find a grouping that fits evenly). Use your own judgment on the exact grouping/order as long as no group exceeds 5 files and the order is stated explicitly with a rationale (e.g. highest-impact first). Update Section 7's routing recommendation to reflect that BACKEND-DEV will receive one Step-3 handoff per iteration (ORCH will dispatch them sequentially, each followed by a build/test check), not a single Step-3 handoff for all 13 files.

result.summary: REWORK 1: restructured src/design/iss0100-tenant-fixture-hygiene.md Section 8 into an explicit 4-iteration sequence (2, 5, 3, 3 files respectively; all <=5, totaling all 13 files) to satisfy WF-03's hard <=5-source-file-per-fix-iteration constraint. Iteration 1 pairs the new GBL-086 migration with tests/integration/helpers.zig (highest leverage, seeds 9 rows on every TestHarness.init()). Iteration 2 covers the SVC/ADP/tenant-config helper-function cluster (5 files). Iterations 3 and 4 split the 6 OIDC files into a shared-ensureTenantBinding-helper trio and an inline-occurrence trio respectively, with Iteration 4 marked FINAL. Section 7 updated to state Step 3 is now a sequence of per-iteration BACKEND-DEV handoffs, each followed by a zig build + narrow zig build test-integration checkpoint, with only the final iteration routing to Step 5 TEST-RUNNER for full-suite verification. PURE REGRESSION FIX fast-path classification (skip TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR) retained. No other content changed: SQL diffs, default-tenant UUID, GBL-086-vs-in-place-edit rationale, and OUT-of-scope file list are untouched from the validator-approved version.
